versions.changelog:
- Documentation improvements and formatting clarifications in SKILL.md
- No changes to core skill logic or functionality
- Updated guidelines for consistent section formatting and output structure

Initial release of Shopify Product Writer.  
- Instantly generates SEO-optimized Shopify product titles, descriptions, meta fields, bullet points, and tags from a simple product brief.
- Supports a wide range of input styles, including lists, supplier copy, and conversational prompts.
- Auto-infers missing details and flags assumptions or conflicts for user review.
- Fully ready-to-paste output, formatted to match Shopify admin panel fields.
- Adheres to strict SEO and readability best practices—no keyword stuffing, always benefit-led.
- Handles error cases (missing product info, non-English briefs, out-of-scope requests) with clear prompts and guidance.
